name: Martin Wills Wildlife Maintenance Trust
summary: Small grants for wildlife charities in the UK and Ireland running projects that protect species and restore and improve habitats.

eligibility.rule: Be a registered charity focused on wildlife and conservation

applicant_types.quote: The Martin Wills Wildlife Maintenance Trust provides grants of £1,000 to £3,000 to small wildlife charities working in the UK and Ireland for projects that protect species and restore habitats.

geography.quote: The Martin Wills Wildlife Maintenance Trust provides grants of £1,000 to £3,000 to small wildlife charities working in the UK and Ireland for projects that protect species and restore habitats.

effort.quote: Applicants can apply for funding by completing our online grant application form and submitting the required documentation, including details of the project, budget, and expected outcomes.

eligibility.quote: Registered charities working in the UK and Ireland and focused on wildlife and conservation
Organisations with an annual income under £2 million

documents.quote: including details of the project, budget, and expected outcomes.
